intent: Render tabular data with sorting, optional row selection, and pagination from one columns/data pair.
typical_uses: Tabular data with more rows than fit on one screen, where the user sorts a column
A list the user selects rows from for a bulk action
Paged results the user steps through instead of scrolling one long list

dont_use_when.rule: Static markup with no sorting, selection or pagination need

invariants.text: `columns` and `data` are both generic over the same `TData` - a `ColumnDef` built for one row shape used against a `data` array of a different shape is a type error at the call site, not a runtime contract this schema can assert.

`enableRowSelection` alone makes rows selectable and turns on the footer's "N of M row(s) selected" text; it renders no checkbox column by itself. A checkbox column only appears when `columns` also includes one built with `dataTableSelectionColumn()`.

`pageSize` seeds and live-resyncs the internal pagination state; zero or negative values make the page-index rescale on prop change (`current.pageIndex * current.pageSize / pageSize`) divide by zero or go negative, so it must stay a positive integer.

anti_patterns.dont: Mix column defs built against different TFeatures objects in one `columns` array
anti_patterns.instead: Build every column with `dataTableColumnHelper()` (or a hand-rolled helper bound to the same `dataTableFeatures`), never a mix

anti_patterns.dont: Set `enableRowSelection` and expect a checkbox column to appear on its own
anti_patterns.instead: Include `dataTableSelectionColumn()` in `columns` explicitly - the flag and the column are independent opt-ins

assumptions.claim: TData is a generic type parameter with no concrete shape
assumptions.reason: JSON Schema has no notion of a generic type parameter; `columns` and `data` stay annotation-only (slots) in the compiled contract rather than typed properties - there is no TData to type them against without a concrete consumer.

assumptions.claim: columns is an array of @tanstack/react-table ColumnDef objects
assumptions.reason: ColumnDef carries function-valued fields (header/cell render functions among them) from a third-party package this contract does not own; it is opaque to the provider-safe JSON Schema subset the same way a function prop is, and is declared as an extension_point instead of enumerated.

assumptions.claim: selectionSummary is a function prop, not data
assumptions.reason: `(selected, total) => ReactNode` has no JSON Schema representation; it is a function returning a plurals-aware sentence, not a value this schema can assert shape against.

assumptions.claim: sorting, row-selection and pagination state are internal, not props
assumptions.reason: `sorting`/`rowSelection`/`pagination` are component-owned useState, never lifted to DataTableProps - "DataTable is sortable/selectable/ paginated" is discoverable only from `columns`' own fields and `enableRowSelection`, not from this contract's prop schema.

good.title: Sortable, selectable, paginated table

bad.title: enableRowSelection with no selection column
bad.why: Without a column built by `dataTableSelectionColumn()` in `columns`, rows become internally selectable (the footer count can change) but nothing in the rendered table lets a user actually select one - the flag and the column are independent opt-ins, and this omits the second one.

extension_points.name: columns
extension_points.description: Column definitions - what data each column reads, how its header and cells render, and whether it participates in sorting. The one required way to shape what DataTable renders.

extension_points.name: dataTableColumnHelper
extension_points.description: A createColumnHelper pre-bound to DataTableFeatures - the one column helper every DataTable column def should be built with.

extension_points.name: dataTableSelectionColumn
extension_points.description: Ready-made row-selection column (checkbox header/cell) a consumer spreads into `columns` to opt into selectable rows.

extension_points.name: dataTableFeatures
extension_points.description: The fixed TanStack Table v9 feature set DataTable registers - row selection, row sorting, row pagination. Not itself configurable per instance; a consumer needing a different feature set (filtering, column visibility, grouping, ...) builds directly against `useTable` instead (see data-table.md's Escape hatch).
